method_notes.cost_of_equity: programme CAPM: rf 5.17% + Blume beta x ERP 4.14%; sensitivities +1 point; terminal g 3%
method_notes.banks: P/TBV vs ROTCE (P/B vs ROE as cross-check); implied ROTCE = g + P/TBV x (CoE - g); in_line = within +/-2 points of the evidence base
method_notes.cash_flow_names: FCF after SBC, interest income removed, net debt and noncontrolling interest on the right entity; 10 explicit years then 3% terminal
